question: Find the display names of users who (1) own posts that received at least one negative comment (score < 60), (2) earned a 'Student' badge in either 2010 or 2011, and (3) have posted at least one question (PostTypeId = 1).

arguments.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT u."XCL_055"
FROM users AS u
WHERE u."XCL_052" IN (
    SELECT p."XCL_033"
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p."XCL_027" = 1
      AND p."XCL_033" IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM comments AS c
          WHERE c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026"
            AND c."XCL_007" < 60
      )
)
AND u."XCL_052" IN (
    SELECT b."XCL_002"
    FROM badges AS b
    WHERE b."XCL_003" = 'Student'
      AND (STRFTIME('%Y', b."XCL_004") = '2010' OR STRFTIME('%Y', b."XCL_004") = '2011')
)
